name: Ruou de Go Den
summary: A rice spirit from Gò Đen in the old Long An half, one of the province’s named specialties.
origin: The old Long An half of Tây Ninh, joined to the province by Resolution 202/2025/QH15.
howToEat: Buy a bottle to carry home.
where: A shop at số 05, ấp 3B, xã Mỹ Yên, formerly xã Phước Lợi, huyện Bến Lức.
seoDescription: Rượu đế Gò Đen, the rice spirit of the old Long An half.
